notes.title: VRacer major update! Cross play with Quest
notes.notes:
Hello Racers!

We’re excited to roll out our latest update—now live on Steam! Last Thursday we launched on Quest 3, and new players have been tearing it up in multiplayer all weekend. Here’s what’s new:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/bdab2f1c1991ca9b85027d9d7b647d290b8a7769.png"]

Cross-Play with Meta Quest

Full cross-play support for online leaderboards, ghosts, and multiplayer.

Challenge a larger pool of racers or just hang out in shared lobbies.

As we are moving to cross platform, for compatibility reasons, you will have a new profile when launching the game and start fresh with the progression



Enhanced Multiplayer Experience

See other players in the multiplayer lobby and gesture at each other.

Easier entry into multiplayer: get notified whenever there’s action going on.

Temporary “mini-championship” leaderboards track your scores during each session.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/1e36bdce5a1bec7398e56ef4e6e9821b622b68fd.jpg"]

bHaptics Suit Integration

Full support for bHaptics suits for a deeper haptic experience.

Enter our V-Racer bHaptics Giveaway for a chance to win your own suit!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/25be94c86870576d5e8956d21f9da8f0dcdf444e.jpg"]

Long-Term Multi-Platform Support

We’ve overhauled much of our codebase to keep PCVR, Quest, and the upcoming PSVR2 versions in sync.

PCVR now runs on OpenXR for broader headset compatibility—plus a new controller calibration tool to support even more devices out of the box.



Quality-of-Life Upgrades

Redesigned lobby with dedicated rooms for the Garage and Progression, plus a new Showroom for in-game photos.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/afc547e6192144daf67b45b7e326a7d3e7f2fa1d.jpg"]

Streamlined onboarding and progression systems.

Introducing our beta Replay Editor—easily clip and share highlights from your best races.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/ee809e32fc98c9ddbb200c7a3d1b300c54c8c7cf.jpg"]

Hoverbikes

Each hoverbike now boasts its own distinct handling profile.

Introduced a brand-new bike L-04 Lockstar ( Rookie Series)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/0e9e3c260345d6d69f6ea7948a7fe3eaada433db.jpg"]

Track

The Neopolis circuit has been completely overhauled to showcase the city’s towering skyline.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/d25730c1f9e3282b143993ec0787667a879972fc.jpg"]

A few more things

XBOX controller support has caused problems in the past. In this version we moved to using thumbsticks if you don’t like leaning

If you prefer the older version for some reason, we are keeping it live on the beta channel, but it will not be maintained in the future. You will keep your older profile with your progression and skins



Discord is where it’s at if you want to meet other players: https://discord.gg/e8vqws8





What’s Next?

PCVR and Quest will continue to receive simultaneous updates.

A content and graphics upgrade is coming alongside the PSVR2 launch later this year—stay tuned!



Thank you for your ongoing support over the years. Strap on your helmet and get ready—the race goes on!




The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: Getting ready for the major update.
notes.notes:
Hello racers,



We are very close to releasing a major update for the game. This update will contain all the stuff we developed for the Quest version launching on june 26. We will have a separate post to highlight what's new.



But before that, we need to verify that the game works with all XR controllers. We have tested with the following controllers:

Oculus Rift/Reift S controllers

Meta Quest2/3 controllers

HTC VIVE wands



If you have controllers not listed above and would like to help us validate them, please answer to this post. As we are now using OpenXR, most controllers should be supported in terms of triggers/thumbsticks/buttons, but we have seen that hand alignment may vary from one controller type to another. That's why we need you to make sure hands are properly aligned for you in the game.



To check that your controllers will work in the game, download this tool: VRacer Calibrator

This is an executable that you can launch on your PC with your headset plugged-in, and it will guide you through the two minutes process. For any questions related to controllers, please ask in this thread.



Thanks for your help!



The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: V-Racer Hoverbike – Update coming soon & Future Plans!
notes.notes:
Hello Racers!
We know many of you have been wondering about the future of V-Racer Hoverbike, and we have some big news to share!

PC Version – Final Release & Crossplay!
After a long Early Access journey, we’re excited to announce that the PC version of V-Racer Hoverbike will soon transition to a full release! As part of this update, we are adding crossplay with Meta Quest players, bringing more competition and a bigger multiplayer community! (The game is launching on Quest this spring, maybe PSVR2 some day)

New Content Incoming!
We’re not stopping at crossplay—we have exciting new content on the way!
We have even more features in the works that we’ll reveal soon. Stay tuned for updates, and as always, thank you for your support!

Let us know in the comments what you’re most excited about!
See you on the track!

notes.title: MEGA UPDATE RELEASED
notes.notes:
Hello racers,

The wait is over. The MEGA UPDATE is here!!!
And it features everything we've mentioned in previous posts:

- complete rework on the menu system to make it full 3D with finger touch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/cf08f064c27e58222a7fbba5cac02c815f412d31.jpg


- a career mode with championships, progression, achievements and unlockables

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/f0e50ff88d990881e304fba98f3a53ea8f5d49c7.jpg


- new bikes, new suits, new helmets, that you can skin in the livery editor

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/1d43d8d1b8a33fa84dcc684279fc12296541a6c7.jpg


- new SURVIVOR and NEON RUNNER game modes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/06e6d0b7e3529c93a009a91aeeedd35665037ce2.jpg


- and a gazillion small improvements that bring the game to the level we envisioned when we started

Thank you all for supporting the game since its release in early access! With this update, you will most likely not recognize the game ;-)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/5df2c6a85c98352662394e1289f2a81e87ad4a2e.jpg

With this update, we have reset the leaderboards and XP so that you can experience the game and its progression as it is intended.

Why do we call this a mega update and not a final release? Well, because we still plan to add significant features to further improve replayability, so stay tuned!
(you'll find out what we mean by that in the game itself, on the main menu ;-)

Anyway, time for us to grab a beer and celebrate! Enjoy the game and let us know what you think!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: MEGA-UPDATE COMING THIS FALL
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409831/18cd31949a6074667224be8902fee4dc34f50216.jpg
Hello racers,

We just started alpha testing for a mega-update that will drop this fall.

After adding all those race tracks, we decided to focus on making the whole game more consistent and challenging to play. The update encompasses a lot of areas, but here are a few of the things it will include:
- a completely redesigned menu system with virtual hands and finger touch
- a livery editor that now lets you customize not only your bike, but also your suit and helmet
- a career mode with increasing difficulty across several championships
- all tracks reskinned in "Neon style", available in two new game modes
- improved multiplayer with a spectator mode suited for livecasting and e-sports events
- progression system with unlockables (including bike models, suits, helmets, liveries and more)

We'll give you more details as we get closer to release.
In the mean time, have fun racing!

The VertexBreakers team

notes.title: New update available: 30 RACES MILESTONE!
notes.notes:
30 RACES MILESTONE!

Hello racers! We've been quiet for a while, but we are happy to announce that we just pushed an update that contains 7 new races, bringing the total to 30! Along with the new Zakhar Frontier track, we've taken the time to make reverse versions of all the HGP tracks.

We only had 4 races when we first launched in early access. We'd like to thank you all for your great support! Now that we have all those races, we can focus on what's coming next. We've teased the Neon tracks a while back, rest assured they are coming: you will get all 30 races in a new game mode with those neon style visuals. We're also looking at the career mode, and a few other surprises for the future.

In the mean time, have fun racing, and thanks again for supporting us!

The VertexBreakers Team

notes.title: First update coming soon - Beta branch
notes.notes:
Hello racers!

First of all we'd like to thank every player that joined the community during the launch this weekend. This has been a thrill for us to hear your first reactions to the game!

In order to deliver updates, we've set up an alpha and beta branch. Alpha is for our own testing, beta is for public testing. Every time we publish an update, we will push it to beta first, and migrate it to the release if you don't report any show stopper bugs in the discussion.

For those willing to play the beta branch, right click on the application in steam, select properties. The last tab on the right is where you select the branch you want to play on (right now you will only see the alpha branch, but the beta will show as soon as we post the first beta).

So the first update is coming in a few moments (need to feed the kids first ;-), stay tuned!

notes.title: V-Racer Hoverbike early access release on april 13th!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This is just to let you know that V-Racer Hoverbike will be live on April 13th as planned!

We've been hard at work polishing and optimizing lately, especially to provide a 90FPS experience from day one to players with GTX 970 or GTX 1060 graphics cards.

As announced, the game features four tracks to play on, and also lists three more tracks as "coming soon". Our plan is to have updates on a regular basis, with more tracks and other features (new weapons, to start with).

We hope you'll all enjoy the game and participate in the community hub to give us feedback and helps us improve the game and prioritize what's coming next.

If you are having fun with it, we'll need all your help to let other players know and build a strong community around the game. Our facebook page (www.facebook.com/vertexbreakers/) is a good place to do that. Join us there and share!

Looking forward to talking to you in the community hub!

The Vertex Breakers team
